issues.description: The Farm class exposes the farm-song API under different identifiers: the problem statement and the template expect a public method named singFarmSong(), but the provided solution implements this functionality as playFarmSong(). This naming mismatch can confuse students (and tests) about which method to implement or call and may lead to failing references when comparing template/problem code to the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across artifacts. Rename the solution's playFarmSong() to singFarmSong(), or add a public singFarmSong() method in the solution that delegates to playFarmSong(). Ensure the template, problem statement, and solution all reference the same method name.
